rows.label: bf05180100_0060
rows.name: (There you go saying things like that again...)

rows.label: bf05180100_0090
rows.name:
Your audience with His Holiness
is scheduled for tomorrow.

rows.label: bf05180100_0100
rows.name:
Why don't you all have a look around the parish
first?

rows.label: bf05180100_0120
rows.name:
See the sights of Acedia? Sounds
like a pretty rare opportunity!

rows.label: bf05180100_0130
rows.name:
I'm interested, mo! I want to travel
all over the place, mo!

rows.label: bf05180100_0140
rows.name: We're completely in tourist mode now.

rows.label: bf05180100_0160
rows.name: This would be a first for me, too.

rows.label: bf05180100_0170
rows.name:
Of course. With that size, if you wandered
around town, it would cause panic.
